info.title: Spartan Cloud APIs
info.description: Powered by Costal Cloud. Current master-to-node provisioning and standalone routing APIs, plus optional provisioning and recovery Worker endpoints. HMAC-SHA256 signs timestamp + newline + uppercase method + newline + pathname + newline + raw body. Timestamps are milliseconds within five minutes; GET signs an empty body. Credentials are literal strings. Exact raw bytes must be sent; do not follow redirects. Header auth controls cannot calculate signatures automatically. See API.md for full integration flow and current regional-routing limitations.

post.description: Does not provision containers. active normalizes to ready. Identity and primary are immutable. A status change needs a higher lifecycleVersion; termination cannot be reversed. Maximum body 65,536 bytes.

get.description: Use the routing control hostname; includes this visitor IP, selected node, and agent connection status. Not a tenant inventory.

post.summary: Create or resume tenant container on one node
post.description: Call both nodes with the same persistent ID, key, fingerprint, primary and lifecycle version. Send initialAdmin only to the primary. A 200 provisioning response requires retries. Maximum body 16,384 bytes. Node operational and most validation failures return 503 operation_failed.

400.description: Malformed JSON; most other node validation failures return 503

503.description: Node validation or operational failure: operation_failed

post.summary: Suspend or terminate tenant on one node
post.description: Call both nodes. Resume through /control/provision with a higher version. Termination removes containers but preserves data and backups; no revival under the same ID.

400.description: Malformed JSON; most other node validation failures return 503

503.description: Node validation or operational failure: operation_failed

get.description: Uses X-Spartan-Origin rather than HMAC. Does not inspect individual tenants.

post.summary: Select bounded repair using optional Llama Worker
post.description: Optional provisioning Worker only. Diagnostic limit 2,048 decoded characters. No raw logs or arbitrary commands. Configured global daily budget 1–20 model calls per UTC day, at least 60 seconds apart. May return manual without a model call.

400.description: Invalid request or JSON; node control errors usually return 503 instead

429.description: Recovery rate limit or daily budget exhausted

post.summary: Move an existing tenant onto the node's configured image
post.description: Compares the running container's image to SPARTAN_IMAGE and recreates the container when they differ. The pull happens before the container is stopped. Responds with status current, upgraded, rolled_back or provisioning. Refused for suspended or terminated tenants and when no container exists.

503.description: Refused or failed; the node log carries the reason

Timestamp.name: X-Spartan-Timestamp
Timestamp.description: Decimal Unix milliseconds; calculate with signature for each request.

Signature.name: X-Spartan-Signature
Signature.description:
Lowercase HMAC-SHA256 of timestamp

OriginSecret.description: Literal ORIGIN_SECRET, for internal health and ingress requests only.

password.description: No control characters. Always creates a superadmin; do not supply role.
